Regarding the operational processes at Fashion Forward, the primary bottleneck is the outdated First-In-First-Out (FIFO) storage system. This system creates inefficiency because newer stock is placed behind older items, making it difficult to access recent inventory. Consequently, the warehouse incurs significant time costs due to the need for manual reorganization whenever newer items are required for shipment. To improve efficiency, Fashion Forward should consider implementing a more flexible storage solution, such as a dynamic slotting system or a warehouse management system (WMS) that optimizes pick paths and allows for easier access to high-turnover or newer items without requiring extensive physical reorganization.
